verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only developer building blocks for AI: Functions-based AI app building, VectorsDB embeddings and similarity search, and image-labeling use cases. It also shows an MCP server and skills that let external agents operate on a project. None of this documents the product itself producing AI-generated insights or suggestions from a user's data inside the Appwrite console, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
